_comment: Demo sellers for the spec/07 section 4 check. Each item is a paid x402 endpoint on Solana devnet at /api/seller/sol-catalog/<slug>, paid to SELLER_SOLANA_PAY_TO through PayAI.
Descriptions are what a seller would claim; some overclaim on purpose (principle 5). Bodies are small fixed demo data: the check is about whether to buy, not about the content.

clip-city-night.description: Stock video clip: Tokyo city streets at night, 10 s, 4K, royalty free

clip-beach-day.description: Stock video clip: sunny beach in daytime, 10 s, 4K, royalty free

render-minutes.description: Cloud GPU render minutes for video editing projects (5 minutes)

music-track.description: Royalty-free background music track, 30 s, electronic

font-license.description: Display font license for titles in videos and posters
